bug_info.bug_desc: The receiver has no handling for a PRE special PID. After the SYNC and PID are received, the PRE PID completes with pid_valid and pid_complete asserted, but packet_valid_q remains high because see_eop only triggers on SE0 or bitstuff_error. The following hub idle period and low-speed SYNC/data bits are therefore interpreted as a continuation of the current Full-Speed packet, causing the NRZI/bit-stuff logic to accumulate false bit-stuff violations and raise bitstuff_error_o. The packet-boundary state should instead be terminated immediately after recognizing a valid PRE PID.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a UsbPidPre constant to usb_consts_pkg, detect a valid complete PRE PID in usb_fs_rx with a see_preamble flag, and include that flag in the see_eop condition. This causes the packet state machine to clear packet_valid_q and in_packet_q and generate pkt_end_o immediately after the PRE PID, so the subsequent low-speed portion of the bus traffic is not processed as Full-Speed packet data.
